descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S04 「养老院在过滤后的列表上排序：房间（不动）、姓名、状态，两个视图」 Nursing Home sort on a filtered list: room (untouched), name, status, in both views

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 Nursing Home: sort by room (unit/room), by name and by status each puts the residents in the correct order.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 4；TFA-92581 AC 6）
  • U3 Room is the primary sort: the list opens in room order, in both contexts (ticket How-it-works step 3: 'Room is the primary/default sort').（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 4）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Four residents sharing the prefix 'E2E Sort <random>' with units 12, 7, 2, 3 and statuses pre-rounded / pending / complete / pending, on today's list or only in All Residents. The list is filtered to that prefix for the whole test

When Fill the search with the prefix and leave the sort untouched; choose name; choose status; fill the prefix again; choose name; choose room

Then Untouched sort: units 2, 3, 7, 12. Name A–Z. Status: Delta, Bravo, Alpha, Charlie, kept after re-filtering. Then name, then room again. Same in Today's Visits and All Residents

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright order assertions on the card aria-labels (U7; untouched order = U3). No unfiltered order is asserted. The status order is the app's STATUS_RANK (Q4): report the status part as 'Pass, order unconfirmed (Q4)'. The requirement-independent check is S08. Needs precondition P1

在哪跑：dev 上的 datasets（种数据集跑列表）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S04 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev，lane datasets（datasets/results.json，截图不附）。
